items.headline: RBI hikes repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%, shifts stance to calibrated tightening
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India increased its policy repo rate to 5.50% and adopted a 'calibrated tightening' stance, prioritizing inflation control. CPI inflation is projected at 5.8% for the next three quarters, with real GDP growth at 7.1% for FY27.

items.headline: India's CPI inflation rises to 5.54% in September, WPI hits 11.4%
items.summary: India's Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation increased to 5.54% in September, up from 4.83% in August, driven by higher food and fuel prices. Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation also saw a sharp rise to 11.4%, indicating broadening price pressures.

items.headline: Finance Ministry warns of continued inflation risks from crude, freight, and El Niño
items.summary: The Finance Ministry's Monthly Economic Review highlights persistent inflation risks from elevated crude oil prices, disrupted maritime freight routes, and potential El Niño-related agricultural issues, making inflation management a key priority.

items.headline: Global markets mixed as US tech sell-off follows disappointing Alphabet earnings
items.summary: Global sentiment is mixed after the US Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged, while Wall Street experienced a tech-led sell-off due to poor Q3 earnings from major firms like Alphabet. Asian markets show divergent trends.

items.headline: Brent crude prices surge above $113 on prospect of US military action
items.summary: Brent crude prices gained over 2% in Asia, rising above $113 per barrel, driven by the prospect of further military action by the US against Iran, indicating increased geopolitical tensions and potential supply concerns.

items.headline: Coal India reports 57% surge in Q2 FY27 consolidated profit
items.summary: Coal India announced a 57% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax to Rs 6,547 crore for Q2 FY27, with revenue from operations growing by 20.8%.

items.headline: V-Guard Industries Q2 profit jumps 71% to Rs 111.67 crore
items.summary: V-Guard Industries reported a 71% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 profit, reaching Rs 111.67 crore, indicating strong financial performance.

items.headline: Trent reports 22.5% revenue growth in Q2 FY27, net profit up 8.6%
items.summary: Trent's Q2 FY27 revenue grew by 22.5% year-on-year, and net profit increased by 8.6%. The company also announced a leadership change.

items.headline: Suzlon Energy Q2 net profit declines despite higher revenue
items.summary: Suzlon Energy reported a sharp decline in net profit for Q2 FY27, despite achieving higher revenue during the quarter.

items.headline: Indian IT stocks under pressure amid FPI outflows and global tech sell-off
items.summary: Indian IT stocks are facing significant pressure due to nearly $10 billion in foreign portfolio investor (FPI) outflows since October 2024, compounded by a major sell-off in Alphabet following its Q3 earnings.

items.headline: FMCG and PSU Banks support Indian equity benchmarks, aiding market recovery
items.summary: FMCG and PSU Bank sectors provided crucial support to Indian equity benchmarks on Thursday, contributing significantly to a broader market recovery.

items.headline: Indian Toners & Developers to list on NSE Mainboard today
items.summary: The equity shares of Indian Toners & Developers will be listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) Mainboard today, October 30, 2026, which is expected to enhance the company's liquidity and visibility.

items.headline: Key IT stocks in focus due to FPI outflows and global tech sector weakness
items.summary: Major IT stocks such as Infosys, TCS, Wipro, and Tech Mahindra are expected to be closely watched today following substantial FPI outflows from the sector and a significant global tech sell-off.
